_comment: The case size and age cannot catch. pg_dump died halfway; the shell reported gzip's exit code, so this run looks flawless from the outside: exit 0, 41 MB (well over the 1 MB floor), written seconds before the run finished. Only reading the artifact back finds it, which is what --verify-integrity does. Classified `failed`.

integrity.detail: the gzip stream did not decompress to a clean end (EOFError: Compressed file ended before the end-of-stream marker was reached). A truncated or checksum-failing stream means the writer did not finish -- the artifact is incomplete.
